address_bytes.bytes_formula: 4 * ( sum_f card_f * R  +  sum_k R * r_k  +  2 * sum_k r_k )
address_bytes.note: EXTRA to gen_store.store_bytes and reported beside it, never inside it -- the same rule gen_request_head.head_bytes states for the incumbent head, so the two reads are compared on the same ledger.

byte_ledger.what: 64 atoms x 2048 float32 -- the per-well leading principal subspace, the SAME block a field or wave-3 store's atoms occupy

content: per-well principal subspace of the fit pool (unsupervised)

head_bytes.note: this read's address book IS the tensor book, declared beside the store and never netted in

label_use: labels align the wells ONCE at fit time and ground the address book; the CONTENT is unsupervised (charter B.6)

request_only.statement: the read's only inputs are the address book, the store and the request; no feature tensor enters launch, settle or read (charter B.3)
